title: Retired safekeeping account on equity buy
symptom: Custodian rejected a settlement instruction with INVALID_SAFEKEEPING_ACCOUNT. The receiving safekeeping account on the instruction had been closed after a custody migration.
verifiedResolution: Looked up the portfolio's current active safekeeping account in the account directory, confirmed the old account was retired, and amended only the receiving account on the existing instruction after approval.

title: Quantity mismatch between broker and custodian
symptom: Custodian instruction quantity 1000 did not match the broker's executed quantity 100. Instruction rejected as unmatched.
verifiedResolution: Not an account problem. Escalated to the trade support desk to cancel and rebook; no account amendment was made.

title: Instruction pending, not rejected
symptom: Operations flagged an instruction as failed, but the custodian status was PENDING_MATCH awaiting counterparty instructions.
verifiedResolution: No amendment required. Waited for counterparty matching; amending a pending instruction would have created a duplicate.

title: Account field moved in the new directory payload
symptom: Account directory response no longer contained the settlementAccount field after a directory release. The integration could not read the receiving account and reported the account as missing.
verifiedResolution: Read the directory's live /contract endpoint, found schema version 2 where the account moved to delivery.safekeepingAccount, parsed it with the validated version 2 adapter, and confirmed the active account before proposing the amendment.

title: Account authorized for a different portfolio
symptom: Directory returned an active safekeeping account, but it was authorized for portfolio P-22 rather than the instruction's portfolio.
verifiedResolution: Rejected the proposed account because portfolio scope did not match. Routed to manual review with the directory evidence attached.

title: Duplicate amendment after timeout retry
symptom: A settlement amendment timed out and an operator resubmitted with a new request ID. The custodian applied the account change twice and issued two receipts.
verifiedResolution: Root cause was retrying without an idempotency key. Policy changed to persist one operation ID before sending and to query the custodian operation record before any retry.

title: Custodian operations endpoint temporarily unavailable
symptom: After sending an amendment, the custodian operation lookup returned 503 for several minutes, so the outcome could not be confirmed.
verifiedResolution: Held the case pending without retrying the amendment. When the endpoint recovered the receipt was present and the case was verified.

title: Unrecognized directory response schema
symptom: Account directory returned schemaVersion 3 with a routing.custodyLeg structure that no adapter supported.
verifiedResolution: Did not guess the account. Sent the case to manual review until a version 3 adapter was written and validated.

title: Security identifier mismatch
symptom: Custodian instruction referenced security XYZ.B while the broker trade was for XYZ. Instruction rejected for unknown security.
verifiedResolution: Trade support corrected the security reference; not a receiving account issue.

title: Unverified note: switch account without checking directory
symptom: Settlement instruction rejected for an invalid account; an analyst note suggested copying the account from a previous trade.
verifiedResolution: Unreviewed suggestion, never verified. Copying accounts between trades bypasses the directory authority.
